items.title: Show HN: MakeWorks 98 – a game in a desktop simulation
items.contentSnippet:
Hi HN. MakeWorks 98 is a low stress game set in a simulation of a late 90s desktop.
You play by doing the job: answering mail in Lookout Express, chatting with simulated colleagues in Natter, adding up favours in the spreadsheet, and doing small Paint jobs. Over a year of in-game days you get promoted, people join and leave, and a daft office story goes on.

The plan has precise, targeted drugs for their gene changes with FDA status, options beyond standard care, missing tests and matching trials. items.title: Show HN: Win Stats – open-source system monitoring in the Windows taskbar
items.contentSnippet:
I've built a small Windows utility called Win Stats that shows live system stats directly in the taskbar.
I used to open Task Manager multiple times just to check RAM usage, CPU/GPU usage, temperatures and other system stats. I wanted something that could show all of this at a glance.
It's Similar to the popular macOS app called Stats
It supports CPU, RAM, GPU, disk speeds, network usage, CPU/GPU temperatures and customizable layouts.

items.title: Show HN: teletap – Your remote coding agents ask you when stuck
items.contentSnippet:
Hi HN!
I'm Manuel, CTO of Tandem.
Most of our PRs are now written by custom coding agents on remote hosts. But we had a recurring problem: they sometimes lacked product context and consequently guessed too much. This resulted in some PRs coming back a bit off, with some wrong choices. We ended up  spending more time fixing the PRs than if we had made them ourselves.
So we built teletap, first for ourselves, and now for everyone.
